question: How does the present teaching relate to the earlier account based on qualities?
premises: An earlier account was given in terms of qualities.
The present account concerns Śiva-Śakti nature.
The listener is asked to hear this account.
inference: After the earlier account based on qualities, the teaching now turns to the Śiva-Śakti nature.
plain_english: It was told before in terms of the qualities; now hear it as having the nature of Śiva and Śakti.
